name: io.github.arhancanli/canli-markets-mcp
title: Canli Markets
description: SEC filings, insider trades, 13F holdings, Treasury yields and FRED data from the sources; no key.

environmentVariables.name: SEC_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Your name and email for SEC's fair-access policy, e.g. "Jane Doe jane@example.com" (optional).

environmentVariables.name: ALPACA_API_KEY_ID
environmentVariables.description: Alpaca key id for price_history (optional; paper keys work).

environmentVariables.name: TIINGO_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Tiingo key for price_history if you do not use Alpaca (optional).
